questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Indian Railways located?
questions.hint: The headquarters of Indian Railways is in New Delhi.

questions.question: Which state has the longest railway route in India?
questions.hint: Uttar Pradesh has the largest route kilometer coverage in India.

questions.question: The first train in India ran between Mumbai and:
questions.hint: The first passenger train ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.

questions.question: Who was the first Railway Minister of independent India?
questions.hint: John Mathai was the first Railway Minister of independent India.

questions.question: What is the width of a broad gauge railway track in India?
questions.hint: Broad gauge in India is 5 feet 6 inches (1.676 m).

questions.question: In which year was the capital of India officially shifted from Calcutta to Delhi?
questions.hint: The shift was announced by King George V during the Delhi Durbar of 1911.

questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of British India?
questions.hint: Lord William Bentinck became the first official Governor-General of India under the Charter Act of 1833.

questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.hint: Wular Lake in Jammu and Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the ancient Buddhist religion?
questions.hint: Siddhartha Gautama (Buddha) founded Buddhism in the 6th-5th centuries BCE.

questions.question: National Sports Day of India is celebrated on which date?
questions.hint: National Sports Day is celebrated on August 29 to honor hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand's birthday.

questions.question: Which is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth?
questions.hint: The Pacific Ocean is the largest, covering more than 30% of the Earth's surface.

questions.question: Who was the author of the famous classical book "Geet Govind"?
questions.hint: Jayadeva was a 12th-century Sanskrit poet who wrote Gita Govinda.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common table salt?
A light-year is a standard unit of measurement for:
questions.hint: A light-year is the distance that light travels in a vacuum in one Julian year (approx. 9.46 trillion km).

questions.question: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.hint: Mitochondria generate most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), used as chemical energy.
